sources.entry: Liwan - Privacy-first web analytics. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Rust/Docker

summary.one_liner: Liwan is a self-hosted, privacy-first web analytics tool that runs as a single binary or Docker container.
summary.what_it_does: Liwan shows the most-visited pages, where visitors come from, and how traffic changes over time, with a dashboard that updates in real time. Bot filtering is enabled by default. The dashboard and database are built in, so no separate services are needed. It sets no tracking cookies, does not do cross-site tracking, and does not record raw IP addresses. Administrators can choose which data to collect, how long to keep it, and how detailed location data is, and can turn off campaign attribution and session metrics independently. Events can be sent from a small browser script added with one line of HTML, or sent entirely from the server. Teams and accounts can be managed through Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, or any OpenID Connect provider such as Keycloak or Dex.
notable: Single binary or Docker deployment with built-in dashboard and database and no extra services
No tracking cookies and raw IP addresses are not recorded
Configurable data collection and retention, including location detail and campaign/session metrics toggles
OpenID Connect single sign-on with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, Keycloak, or Dex
caveats: The README does not include install or run instructions; see the linked Getting started and Configuration sections
Single sign-on setup requires an external identity provider
